QuestInfo.name: [Hayato] Counterintelligence
QuestInfo.0: Motonari is looking for you. Something must have happened at Momijigaoka.
QuestInfo.1: Oda spies were spotted near Momijigaoka. You can't let them discover your base!
QuestInfo.2: You took care of the Oda Scouts. Momijigaoka is safe for now, but the cases the scouts were carrying is worrisome. They have a familiar four-diamond crest...
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,245\nCan proceed to The Search for Takeda Shingen 1 quest

1.0: I am fairly confident in Momijigaoka's secrecy. Oda's troops seem to stumble about with no orders, and a fog cannot be dispelled by a fan.
1.1: However, I am troubled by the presence of this four diamond crest. It must mean...

default.0: Oh honorable samurai, will you dispatch a troop of Oda Scouts? I know there is a small force to the east. Certainly your trusty blade will not falter.
